model: CM500 CO2 sensor / controller (RS-485 Modbus RTU)
applies_to: CO2Meter.com CM500 with the RS-485 Modbus RTU interface, per the vendor's 'RS485 Communications Modbus Protocol' sheet (no document number).
summary: The CM500 is a CO2 sensor and controller with an RS-485 port that speaks Modbus RTU using FC03 reads and FC06 writes. Readings are single 16-bit registers. The shared register sheet also lists other gas, particulate and RTC registers that only answer on units fitted with those sensors.

addressing.note: Registers are listed as hex addresses sent unchanged in the request; the examples read CO2 with start address 0x0014 (table row 14H).

source.title: CM500 RS-485 Modbus RTU protocol (RS485 Communications Modbus Protocol)

notes: The sheet is served from a Shopify file CDN (cdn.shopify.com) used by CO2Meter's store, not from a CO2Meter-branded host, so it is marked unofficial.
Note 1 on page 2 says the CO2 start address is 0x0B, but the register table and both example frames use 0x14; 0x14 is used here.
Default slave address is printed as 0x068 (104). The examples use 0xFA, which the sheet reserves for broadcast.
Left out: O2, ambient temperature, barometer, RH, dew point and battery voltage (12H, 19H-1DH). The sheet only shows display formats such as 'xx.xx%', not the register scaling.
Writable RTC registers (78H-7BH) are left out because their layout is not described.

registers.name: Slave address
registers.description: 1-249; 250 (0xFA) is reserved for broadcast. Stored in EEPROM.

registers.name: Baud rate
registers.description: Takes effect after a power cycle.

registers.name: UART parity / framing
registers.description: Takes effect after a power cycle.

registers.name: NH3
registers.description: Whole ppm (only on units with this sensor).

registers.name: CO2
registers.description: Whole ppm; the manual's example reads 0x0318 = 792 ppm.

registers.name: CO
registers.description: Whole ppm (only on units with this sensor).

registers.name: VOC
registers.description: Whole ppb (only on units with this sensor).

registers.name: PM2.5
registers.description: Only on units with this sensor.

registers.name: PM10
registers.description: Only on units with this sensor.

integration.summary: Poll 19200 8N1 at address 104 (0x68) with FC03 and read register 0x14 for CO2 in ppm. Change address, baud or parity with FC06 and power-cycle the sensor.
integration.enable: Modbus RTU is the RS-485 interface's protocol; no enable step is described.
quirks: Only FC03 and FC06 are supported.
Baud and parity changes need a power cycle.
setup: Defaults: 19200 baud, 8 data bits, no parity, 1 stop bit.
gotchas: Address 250 (0xFA) is broadcast; do not assign it to a sensor.

address_note: address = 0-based Modbus wire (PDU) address; documented = as printed in the source.
note: Re-typed from the manufacturer's public documentation (see source) and verified against it. Registers vary by firmware and options; verify against the live device before writing.
